title: Correct temporary resume frontend cleanup
objective: Correct live temporary frontend cleanup for plain codex resume. The launcher shell starts detached in its own group, but util-linux script creates the actual exact-match codex resume frontend in a separate process group. Live event event-fb305c44-92a2-4ca1-8fc9-eda3f98d1674 had confirmed rollout acceptance but was correctly recorded UNCERTAIN because cleanup could not be proven. Discover every newly spawned exact session/message frontend group, terminate those temporary groups after confirmation, and prove all launcher and frontend groups are empty with no duplicate frontend left.
scope: src/codex-resume-transport.js process-group discovery, termination, and cleanup evidence
src/wakeup.js receipt validation only if new deterministic cleanup fields are required
relevant_context: Live ps evidence for an earlier wake showed launcher /bin/sh in PGID 3072907, while node codex and vendor codex were in PGID 3072910.
The current code signals only -child.pid, then scans exact-match resume frontends and marks cleanup false when the separate frontend group remains.
The original Herdr host PID 2585062 is not a codex resume frontend and must never be signaled.
New frontend identity must be scoped by exact session UUID and exact unique wake message, compared against the pre-spawn baseline, with validated positive PGIDs.
Plain codex resume argv, exact rollout proof, binding and generation fences, and uncertain no-replay semantics remain fixed.
acceptance_criteria: launcher is still started detached in its own process group
all newly created exact-match frontend process groups are deterministically identified
only the launcher group and newly created exact-match frontend groups are signaled
authoritative Herdr host continuity is verified and the host is never signaled
cleanup succeeds only when launcher exit is observed, every tracked group is empty, and zero new exact-match frontend remains
cleanup failure remains UNCERTAIN and non-replayable
regression covers script-style separate frontend group and duplicate frontend absence
expected_deliverable: A minimal tested cleanup correction that terminates all temporary exact-match resume groups and preserves the original Herdr session.

may: read repository and named durable evidence
modify the transport, directly related wake validation, tests, and minimal related docs
run focused and full local verification
may_not: signal live processes or invoke a live wake
rewrite, retry, consume, or mark delivered historical uncertain events
change policy, objective, supervisor identity, session binding, pause behavior, or host configuration
modify siblings, push, merge, deploy, install, or initialize a repository
